CustomField.description: Visual review status derived from stored review, case, compliance and severity fields.
CustomField.formula: IF(Reviewed__c, "✅ Reviewed", IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Related_Case__c)), "🎫 Case Raised", IF(ISBLANK(Compliance_Reason_Code__c), "⚪ Not Ready for Review", IF(Non_Compliant__c, "🔎 Review Required", IF(TEXT(Severity__c) = "CRITICAL", "👁 Review Recommended", "— No Review Required")))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows whether review is complete, required, recommended or linked to a case.
CustomField.label: Review Status
